Nautical Flag Reference

International Code of Signals maritime flags A–Z, each drawn in full color on canvas with its NATO meaning. Searchable.

Meanings follow the International Code of Signals (single-flag hoists). Tap a card to copy its letter and meaning.

📖 How to use

  1. Browse the full A–Z flag chart, or
  2. search by letter, NATO name, or meaning.
  3. Tap any card to copy its letter + meaning.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are nautical signal flags?

The International Code of Signals (ICS) assigns one flag per letter, each with a standard single-letter meaning used worldwide at sea.

How are the flags drawn?

Every flag is drawn with canvas vector shapes — no images — at a crisp 3:2 ratio.

Can I search by meaning?

Yes — search by letter, phonetic name, or a word from the meaning (try 'diver' or 'pilot').
